name: American Cancer Society Postdoctoral Fellowship
amount: USD 66,000 / 68,000 / 70,000 stipend (years 1-3) + USD 4,000/year allowance + USD 1,500 in final year for a meeting
other_rules: Doctorate no more than 3 years old and/or 3 or fewer years of postdoc research at application
US citizens or non-citizens with appropriate visa or immigration status
postdoc at a US academic institution or eligible nonprofit
notes: Deadlines 1 June and 1 December. Paid parental leave of 4-12 weeks available.
